concepts.title: 비 갠 밤 뉴욕 도심 횡단보도, 바쁜 출근길처럼 멈추지 않고 걷기
concepts.background: 비 갠 밤, 차 없는 뉴욕 맨해튼 도심 사거리 횡단보도 한 곳, 뒤로 높은 석조·유리 빌딩과 불 켜진 창·쇼윈도, 건너편 인도에서 정면으로 본 같은 자리
concepts.background_en: A wide empty Manhattan-style city intersection crosswalk at night after rain, clean white stripes on wet dark asphalt reflecting warm lights, tall classic stone and glass buildings behind with lit windows and shop windows, warm street lamps, no cars, no people, no text, no logos.
concepts.framing: 세로 9:16, 눈높이, 건너편 인도에서 조금 떨어져 촬영, 전신이 화면 높이의 약 55%, 카메라 고정
concepts.light: 비 갠 밤, 따뜻한 가로등·쇼윈도 불빛과 젖은 길의 반사, 어두운 남색 하늘
concepts.motion: 걷기 (왼쪽 끝에서 들어와 멈추지 않고 횡단보도를 건너 오른쪽으로 퇴장, 바쁜 현대인처럼, 커피·휴대폰 소품)
concepts.why: 멈추지 않고 걷는 바쁜 도시 사람의 걸음이라 옷이 걸음과 함께 자연스럽게 움직이고, 밤 불빛이 젖은 길에 비쳐 연말 도심 분위기가 남
concepts.pace: 바쁜 걸음, 보폭 크게, 1초에 약 2.5걸음, 끝까지 같은 속도
concepts.camera_en: Fixed camera at eye level (about 1.5 m high), about 9 m from the crosswalk, facing it squarely from the opposite sidewalk, vertical 9:16, no zoom, no shake, no movement.
concepts.pace_en: Busy city commuter pace: brisk long strides, about two and a half steps per second, the same speed from start to end, shoulders level, head up, no bouncing, no waddling.
concepts.light_en: Night after rain: warm street lamps and shop-window light, reflections on the wet asphalt, dark blue night sky; her face and outfit stay clearly lit and easy to see.
concepts.direction_en: She walks along the crosswalk in one straight line from the left edge of the frame to the right edge and exits on the right, her body side-on to the camera, face in three-quarter view and clearly visible. She never stops, slows down, turns to the camera or poses.

shots.action: 왼쪽 끝에서 들어와 멈추지 않고 바쁘게 걸어 오른쪽으로 퇴장
shots.pose: 오른손에 테이크아웃 커피 컵을 들고, 걸으며 한 번 한 모금 마시기
shots.motion_en: 0-5s: one continuous brisk walk along the crosswalk from the left edge of the frame to the right edge, her body side-on to the camera with her face in a three-quarter view so it stays clearly visible, full body about 55% of the frame height, never stopping, slowing, turning her body to the camera or posing. She holds a plain white takeaway coffee cup with a lid (no logo) in her right hand and takes one quick sip while walking; the shoulder bag stays on her shoulder. At about 4.5s she walks out of frame on the right. One continuous take: no cuts, no scene changes, no close-up inserts. There is no wind: hair and clothes move only with her steps.
shots.start: 화면 왼쪽 끝 횡단보도 위, 전신이 화면 세로의 약 55%, 걷는 중
shots.start_en: Full body at the left edge of the frame on the crosswalk, about 55% of the frame height, side-on to the camera, mid-stride, walking toward the right.

shots.action: 왼쪽 끝에서 들어와 멈추지 않고 바쁘게 걸어 오른쪽으로 퇴장
shots.pose: 오른손에 휴대폰을 들고 걸으며 화면을 한 번 내려다보기
shots.motion_en: 0-5s: one continuous brisk walk along the crosswalk from the left edge of the frame to the right edge, her body side-on to the camera with her face in a three-quarter view so it stays clearly visible, full body about 55% of the frame height, never stopping, slowing, turning her body to the camera or posing. She holds a black smartphone in her right hand and glances down at its screen once while walking, then looks ahead again. At about 4.5s she walks out of frame on the right. One continuous take: no cuts, no scene changes, no close-up inserts. There is no wind: hair and clothes move only with her steps.

concepts.title: 비 갠 밤 네온 거리, 횡단보도 정면으로 걸어오기
concepts.background: 비 갠 밤, 젖은 아스팔트에 불빛이 번지는 차 없는 도심 횡단보도 한 곳, 횡단보도 끝에서 카메라 쪽으로 이어지는 같은 자리
concepts.background_en: A long empty city crosswalk at night after rain, wet dark asphalt with soft warm street light reflections and white stripes leading from the far end of the frame toward the camera, blurred out-of-focus dark buildings with soft warm window lights far behind, no cars, no people, no signs, no text, no logos.
concepts.framing: 세로 9:16, 눈높이, 횡단보도 맞은편 끝에서 정면으로 촬영, 멈출 때 전신이 화면 높이의 약 60%, 카메라 고정
concepts.light: 비 갠 밤, 따뜻한 가로등 빛과 젖은 길의 반사, 어두운 남색 하늘
concepts.motion: 걷기 (횡단보도 먼 끝에서 카메라 쪽으로 빠르게 걸어와 가운데서 잠깐 멈춰 포즈, 왼쪽으로 퇴장)
concepts.why: 어두운 밤길에 가로등 빛이 퍼져 블랙 코디도 윤곽이 보이고, 정면으로 걸어오는 동선이라 옷 전체와 얼굴이 점점 크게 잘 보임
concepts.pace: 보폭 크게, 1초에 약 2.5걸음, 팔은 앞뒤로 힘 있게, 어깨는 수평
concepts.camera_en: Fixed camera at eye level (about 1.5 m high), placed on the near end of the crosswalk looking straight down its length, vertical 9:16, no zoom, no shake, no movement.
concepts.pace_en: Brisk runway-like walk straight toward the camera, long strides, about two and a half steps per second, arms swinging clearly, shoulders level, head up, no bouncing, no waddling.
concepts.light_en: Night after rain, warm street light glow and soft reflections on the wet asphalt, deep navy sky, even light on her.
concepts.direction_en: She walks along the crosswalk from the far end toward the camera, pauses briefly at the center of the frame, then walks out of frame to the left.

shots.action: 횡단보도 먼 끝에서 걸어와 가운데서 잠깐 멈춘 뒤 왼쪽으로 빠르게 걸어 퇴장
shots.pose: 가운데서 잠깐 멈춰 오른손으로 자켓 금단추 옷깃을 매만지고 카메라 보기
shots.motion_en: 0-2.8s: she walks quickly straight toward the camera along the crosswalk, long strides, about two and a half steps per second, arms swinging, growing from about 25% to about 50% of the frame height. 2.8-3.4s: she slows and stops at the center at about 55% of the frame height, facing the camera. 3.4-4.4s: her right hand touches the jacket edge near the gold buttons and smooths it once, the jacket stays closed as in the reference, then she looks at the camera with a small smile. 4.4-5.7s: she turns and walks briskly out of frame to the left with the same long strides. One continuous take: no cuts, no scene changes, no close-up inserts. There is no wind: hair and clothes move only with her steps and hands.
shots.start: 횡단보도 먼 끝 가운데, 전신이 화면 세로의 약 25%, 걷는 중
shots.start_en: Tiny full-body figure at the far end of the crosswalk, horizontally centered, about 25% of the frame height, walking toward the camera, mid-stride with the left foot forward and arms swinging naturally; not posing yet, no clothing adjustments.

shots.pose: 가운데서 잠깐 멈춰 양손 손끝으로 퍼 카라를 쓸어 만지기 (코트는 여민 채)

concepts.title: 이른 아침 주택가, 따라가며 찍는 횡단보도 걷기
concepts.background: 맑은 이른 아침, 차 없는 조용한 주택가 골목의 낮은 연한 크림색 담벼락 앞 횡단보도 한 곳, 늘 같은 길
concepts.background_en: A quiet empty residential street crosswalk early in the morning, white stripes on light grey asphalt, a long plain pale cream low wall and a few bare-branched trees behind, clear pale blue sky, no cars, no people, no signs, no text, no logos. The crosswalk and the street run from right to left across the frame.
concepts.framing: 세로 9:16, 눈높이, 걷는 모델을 옆에서 같은 속도로 따라가며 늘 가운데에, 전신이 화면 높이의 약 60%, 줌·흔들림 없음
concepts.light: 맑은 이른 아침, 옆에서 비스듬히 드는 낮은 햇살, 연한 파랑 하늘과 크림색 담
concepts.motion: 걷기 (옆에서 따라 찍는 카메라, 모델은 늘 가운데에서 걸으며 배경이 흐르고 걷는 채로 포즈)
concepts.why: 카메라가 같은 속도로 따라가 모델이 늘 가운데 같은 크기로 보이고, 크림색 담과 하늘이 옷 색을 방해하지 않으며 배경이 흘러 걸음이 빨라 보임
concepts.pace: 보폭 크게 성큼성큼, 1초에 약 2.5걸음, 팔은 힘 있게 앞뒤로
concepts.camera_en: Camera at eye level (about 1.5 m high), about 6 m to the side of her, tracking sideways at exactly her walking speed so she stays at the center of the frame at the same size, the background flows past, smooth steady movement, no zoom, no shake, vertical 9:16.
concepts.pace_en: Brisk confident walk, long strides, about two and a half steps per second, arms swinging clearly, shoulders level, head up, no bouncing, no waddling.
concepts.light_en: Clear early morning, low sunlight from the side, warm glow on the cream wall, pale blue sky, soft gentle shadows.
concepts.direction_en: She walks along the street from right to left across the crosswalk the whole time, side-on to the camera, always at the center of the frame, without stopping.

shots.action: 가운데에서 오른쪽에서 왼쪽으로 쉬지 않고 걷다 걸으며 포즈
shots.pose: 걸으면서 오른손으로 자켓 금단추 옷깃을 매만지고 카메라 보기
shots.motion_en: 0-1.5s: she keeps walking from right to left along the crosswalk at the center of the frame, long quick strides, about two and a half steps per second, arms swinging, about 55% of the frame height. 1.5-3.5s: still walking at the same pace without stopping, her right hand touches the jacket edge near the gold buttons and smooths it once, the jacket stays closed as in the reference, then she glances at the camera, and her free arm keeps swinging. 3.5-5.5s: she keeps walking at the same pace and size, arms swinging again, looking ahead to the left. One continuous take: no cuts, no scene changes, no close-up inserts. There is no wind: hair and clothes move only with her steps and hands.
shots.start: 화면 가운데, 전신이 화면 세로의 약 55%, 오른쪽에서 왼쪽으로 걷는 중
